lines.text: NFT Ltd disclosed at 16:20 ET on September 30, 2026 an agreement to sell 80,000,000 Class A ordinary shares to non-U.S. purchasers at $0.45 per share, approximately $36 million in total, in a private placement subject to closing conditions. The desk reads the placement as large against an outdated outstanding-share figure and priced below the supplied market price, and our sources do not show that it closed.

Alector disclosed at 07:00 ET on October 5, 2026 a September 30 license agreement with Genentech covering certain GCase candidates, with Genentech leading development and commercialization and Alector keeping its Brain Carrier platform and its own pipeline; the company said the deal extends its cash runway into 2029. The desk reads it as fresh validation and a funding-runway event, with no upfront, milestone or royalty terms in our sources.

Not a fresh catalyst: our sources found only a Fosun Diagnostics supply agreement dated July 9, 2026 and a July 16 shareholder update, with September filings covering a warrant-resale registration and ATM capacity rather than business progress. The desk reads the Fosun deal as a genuine commercial expansion story but too old to account for the present move.

Not a fresh catalyst: QTREX reported at 13:20 ET on October 1, 2026 that an unnamed quantum computing company tested its cryogenic interconnect at 20 mK and found over 100 dB channel isolation across the 4 to 8 GHz qubit band, and said it was finalizing a definitive agreement with that company. The desk treats the isolation result as the material metric, with the counterparty and commercial terms undisclosed.

Not a fresh catalyst: Reliance reported on October 1, 2026 that it completed the sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting for $8 million in cash plus up to $1 million in earnout, and a secondary report at 08:23 ET on October 5, 2026 said it repaid its approximately $4.4 million Oak Street term loan in full. The desk reads this as cash proceeds and deleveraging, with the repayment backed only by secondary coverage.

Not a fresh catalyst: WISeSat.Space completed its business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp. on October 1, 2026, and its shares began Nasdaq trading as SAIQ on October 2, with no transaction value in our sources. The desk reads the new listing as a corporate transition that can draw attention in its first sessions; the name is down 37.5% since the previous checkpoint.

Apimeds' MindWave announced at 08:03 ET on October 5, 2026 an agreement with BlockAssure to build and operate AssureChain, an insurance and reinsurance network, which secondary coverage describes as a two-year contract with 20% of planned token supply going to MindWave and fees not disclosed. The desk reads it as a new customer agreement whose direct financial impact is unquantified.
Research on this name is not on file at this checkpoint.

Not a fresh catalyst: ReTo announced at 11:03 ET on September 29, 2026 a 1-for-20 reverse split effective October 2, after announcing a $15 million registered direct offering for 10,000,000 Class A shares and 10,000,000 warrants whose closing our sources do not confirm. A news-pending halt at 19:50 ET on October 1, 2026 came with no underlying news disclosed in our sources.

Not a fresh catalyst: Veea announced on October 1, 2026 an agreement with TROLLEE Holdings for phased deployment of VeeaONE across 1,000 unattended stores, and secondary coverage associated it with a stock move of approximately 48%. The desk reads the deployment as potentially material, with no contract value, purchase commitments or expected revenue disclosed.

Not a fresh catalyst: VCIG disclosed at 10:32 ET on September 30, 2026 an equity purchase agreement giving it the right, subject to conditions, to direct Hudson Global Ventures to buy up to $125 million of ordinary shares, along with Dune and FirstFire convertible notes, and a September 29 F-1 seeks to register up to 100,000,000 ELOC purchase shares. The desk reads this as financing rather than operating news, and our sources show no put notice and no effective registration.

Our research could not tell whether a catalyst applies: SEC filings at 16:30 ET on September 23, 2026 show the business combination completed, HVII renamed ONE Nuclear Energy Inc., ONEN listed on Nasdaq and approximately $146.5 million in redemption payments. Coverage was SEC-only, with no newsroom or newswire source, so the desk cannot place this event against the move.
